train_masked_lm: train a masked language model using the specified architecture and optional extra flags
train_roberta_head: train a RoBERTa sentence prediction or regression head with a given number of classes
train_legacy_masked_language_model: train a legacy cross-lingual masked language model with configurable encoder architecture and extra args
eval_lm_main: evaluate a trained language model checkpoint on a data directory with optional extra flags
create_dummy_roberta_head_data: create dummy classification or regression data for training a RoBERTa sentence prediction head
